name: Toni Olabanji
bio:
Growing up in Bermondsey, South London, Toni - known on the mic as BANJI - brings an unstoppable energy. Whether he’s commanding the screen as an actor or spitting bars as a rapper, he always delivers with fire. As a founding member of The Spit Game collective, BANJI honed his craft through raw cyphers, both in the studio and on the streets. Rooted in grime, he weaves in elements of jazz, hip-hop, and afrobeat to create a contemporary sound. His rapid flows and unique rhythms echo influences like Stormzy, Skepta, and JME, while bringing something fresh to the scene.

Beyond the music, BANJI leads rap clubs across London, empowering young people to own their culture, develop their skills, and, when needed, re-engage with education. In 2024, he was honored as Best Young Leader at the national Youth Music Awards for his impactful work. Now, as Associate Director of The Spit Game and Head of Rap Clubs, he continues to inspire.

On screen, Toni has starred in and co-produced two BAFTA-qualifying short films and has taken on diverse roles, from an upcoming Pinocchio horror film to projects exploring young Black male vulnerability.

Toni was once a student of, and is currently managed by, Turner.

credits.title: Fair
credits.overview: Boys learn to play life by a simple rule: don't flinch.

credits.title: Get Back Season
credits.overview: In a London school gripped by a viral revenge trend, one school day spirals into violence, shame and chaos. Told through a genre-bending sprawling ensemble structure, Get Back Season is a raw odyssey of power performance and wounded youth.

credits.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
credits.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

credits.title: Dead Fun
credits.overview: A group of friends attend a house party. Waiting through the doors is a wild night, an ex-girlfriend, and n***a zombies.

credits.title: Christmas with the Twins
credits.overview: Jasmine learns she has a royal twin named Sofia. Both were lost at birth, but both want to experience one another's lives.

credits.title: The Nudes
credits.overview: A young woman is alone in her room when her boyfriend asks permission to send her nude. As he sends them, each one appears, coming to life in front of her. But she soon starts being harassed by unwanted nudes from other men.

credits.title: Help! I Think My Teacher is Racist
credits.overview: A group of Black school kids in London are torn between the approaches of two teachers. Based on true stories.
